counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.030120361063014384 to 0.001 - finer integration resolves close encounter, energy conserved, no violation

explanation: High-G (~5.0) with massive bodies (~17.9,19.7) undergo close encounter at step 15-16: separation 0.507 -> 0.340, near softening length 0.3. At large dt=0.0301 (near max 1/30) leapfrog error despite adaptive substeps (28 substeps at step 16) causes huge energy jump: potential -2989 -> -3883, kinetic 2500 -> 3098, total -489.08 -> -785.27, delta 380 > allowed 139.68. Reducing dt to 0.001 eliminates violation, proving cause is integration inaccuracy under strong acceleration during close approach.
vision_note: Two massive blue bodies in the bottom-right approach each other rapidly from steps 13 to 16. By steps 15-16 they nearly overlap and merge, showing a very close encounter near the softening scale.
